professionalSummary: Accountable fraud analytics lead with six years at Corvane Payments, managing a card‑not‑present fraud detection model for e‑commerce merchants in the UK and Ireland.

Expertise in building transaction‑level features, approving threshold changes, tuning alerts with operations, presenting model performance to risk committees, and monitoring real‑time scoring service latency.
experienceHighlights: Fraud data scientist, then fraud analytics lead, at Corvane Payments from 2018 to 2024, working on card‑not‑present fraud detection for e‑commerce merchants in the UK and Ireland.
Built velocity and device‑consistency features from authorisation data, tested each on a holdout month and documented each one in the feature catalogue.
Approved two changes to the decline threshold in 2023 after weekly reviews with the fraud operations manager; both are recorded in the model change log.

Presented the half‑yearly performance review of the card‑not‑present model (detection rate, false‑positive rate and alert volumes) to the model risk committee, with the threshold history and the changes planned for the next half‑year.
Reviewed the scoring service's latency reports with the platform team, which built and ran the real‑time scoring service, and raised two tickets when response times drifted above the agreed limit.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: the model change log entry for the October 2023 decline‑threshold change, with the supporting analysis, the fraud operations manager's comments and the candidate's approval.
